name: ThroneBreaker
source:
🔥 [b]Thronebreaker: Bloodlines of Rebellion[/b]

[i]Every kingdom starts with a betrayal.[/i]

Years ago, your family was slaughtered under the banner of a tyrant king.
Now, after years of strategy, deceit, and rebellion—you’ve taken the throne for yourself. But power has a price. As the crown rests heavy on your head, a darker game begins…

🗡️ [b]A New Threat Rises[/b]

Just when peace seems within reach, you’re struck down by an assassination attempt.
You survive—but barely. Years have passed.
You’re older. Slower. And now… you’re not the only one who bleeds for truth.

Your son takes up the mantle. Together, you must uncover who is behind the dagger… and why your reign still threatens the shadows in your kingdom.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
🔥 [b]王权的陨落：叛乱的血统[/b]

[i]每个王国都是从背叛开始的。[/i]

多年前，你的家族在暴君的旗帜下遭到屠杀。
现在，经过多年的策略、欺骗和叛乱，你已经夺取了王位。但权力是有代价的。当王冠重重地戴在你头上时，一场更加黑暗的游戏开始了……

🗡️ [b]新的威胁出现[/b]

就在和平似乎触手可及时，你却遭遇了一场暗杀企图。
你活了下来——但勉强活了下来。几年过去了。
你年纪大了。慢点。现在……你并不是唯一一个为真理而流血的人。

你的儿子继承了衣钵。你们必须齐心协力，揭开匕首的幕后黑手……以及为何你的统治仍然威胁着你王国的阴影。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831030/]Steam[/url]]
